{{Top|leg}}
The '''Duros Red Credit Brigade''' was a faction during the [[Third Alsakan Conflict]] in [[14,300 BBY]]. They were [[Battle of Raxus Prime (Third Alsakan Conflict)|defeated]] by the rival [[Machinists of Nikato]] who then established an independent state known as the [[Nikato's Bootheel]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]].
